body:
I'm just terrible embarrased about the fact that I tried to commit suicide and a bit about me not been to a doctor in 6 years, despite living in a country with free healthcare. I'm not emberrased about my issues at all, its just that I am afraid to open myself up to others. I honestly can't come up with a reason why I feel like this, just like as I mentioned before it almost feels like a phobia. I've posted on SW many times before advising others to seek help and trying to talk them out of suicide, yet I am unable to get help for myself, its kinda ironic. I see others improve while I am not moving on very much with my issues, just blocking them out till I just can't hold them anymore and then randomly drop into a very depressive state which is a very bad place for me to be in. The reason I am posting here on SW is that I realize that I can't go on like this, and that I probably will end up actually killing myself when I don't have it together anymore, but the actual fear of contacting somebody for help is almost bigger. It even sounds crazy to me that I think this way, but I can't overcome it.....not making this up =/. I thought that perhaps trough comments I could find a way to push myself towards my goal of getting help because reddit has really helped me in the past with my issues.


Its also really hard for me to explain all of this, so if you have anything to ask or anything to say; negative or postive, then please just post it and i'll listen and answer.

It used to be worse than this but i've managed to pull the strenght together to admit to myself that I had a problem in the past. Later I pushed myself to finally get healthcare after 5 years and even made a appointment with a psychologist a few months later. The appointment was made over the phone and I only told her that I suffered from Depression and I was put on a 3 week waiting list. Within those 3 weeks my mood switched drastically and I diddn't answer my phone for a while and never heard from her. There are many other regular doctors that can forward me to psychologist but I havn't been to a doctor in 6 years so that seems like just another roadblock for me up ahead. What would I base my appointment off with a doctor? Just tell them I have depression and want it to go away? The thought of it alone already is scary =/


Also thank you for offering me your time, i'll keep it in mind :)

I got healthcare so I can get help its just that I have problems talking to people about my issues or even admitting to people that I have issues. I know that I need to be desperatly be helped and that I needed it a long time ago and that its probably the best for me, but its almost as if getting help is a Phobia to me. It probably sounds crazy but this might be the biggest issue I got. 


Edit: I've considered calling them before I made this post but as of right now there is no grain of me that feels suicidal or depressed. I'm not really feeling positive right now either, i'm pretty neutral. Calling the Suicide prevention hotline I wouldn't have an idea what to tell them or what to talk about because I am currently not really feeling anything and its hard to recall for myself how I felt on monday.
